name: dialog-slot-composition
proves: declared slot fill authored in the instance scope; open state loop (openChange -> setState, open <- state); confirm control INSIDE the dialog body is an authored element with a declared-action interaction; portal to ControlScope root

outputs.name: openChange
outputs.description: Fires for open requests and Escape/overlay closes.

expected: openChange writes state.dialogOpen (open request and Escape/overlay close both route through the authored binding); dialog body is the authored slot fill resolved in the instance scope; the confirm child dispatches assignment.confirm via the existing element interaction channel; focus moves into the dialog on open and returns on close (implementation-provided, bits-ui focus scope); portal renders to the ControlScope root, not document.body
